captions.detailed: This 3D model features a benchtop monocular microscope with a light-gray painted body and black mechanical components. It consists of a heavy rectangular base, an arched yoke arm supporting an angled eyepiece tube, a rotating nosepiece turret with multiple objectives, and a flat square stage assembly. The stage assembly slides prismatically forward and backward on a lower guide, the nosepiece rotates on a revolute turret below the tube, and a small lamp-access door under the stage rotates on a side-mounted vertical hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a benchtop monocular microscope with a light-gray yoke arm and a black stage. The stage assembly should slide prismatically along a lower guide, the objective nosepiece should rotate on a revolute turret below the tube, and a small lamp-access door under the stage should rotate on a side-mounted vertical hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by defining an ArticulatedObject. Create the fixed base, yoke arm, and angled eyepiece tube using nested box and cylinder primitives. Model the stage assembly as a separate part connected via a prismatic joint to allow fore-and-aft movement. Model the objective turret below the tube using a revolute joint, and attach the small lamp-access door beneath the stage with a revolute joint representing the vertical hinge.
